column1: # Brazil (BR) business registries — best-effort scrape entries (kind=scrape).
# Companies are identified by CNPJ (Receita Federal). No MCP endpoints exist, so
# the agent does a domain-scoped scrape of each site and gives up / continues to
# the next if a site yields nothing. The BrasilAPI CNPJ service is additionally
# wired as a structured search provider (app/search/providers/brasil.py).
